decision: GO for exactly one official private standalone check of frozen source; not a promotion or scored-publication verdict

review.scope: Read entire parent-to-candidate diff and actual routing, loaders, compute loop, helper, preissue, run_phase, finalizer, allocation and host launch paths. Exact Python AST changes are CUDA_SRC, _ext namespace and three small build tuples. All packing, prepare, scratch and shape dispatch nodes unchanged.
review.address_and_arithmetic: NW4 consumes original warp regions2*w and2*w+1. Scale records are512B apart and selected with local chunk0..7; full chunk c0..15 selects correct unchanged packed codes and x registers. NACC4 accumulators are initialized before both groups and reduced afterward. Actual code/dequantization/BF16 scale and activation operands are validated; FP32 grouping8->4 changes and requires GPU numeric tests.
review.routing: For every M1..16, E=8M<=128 and CH32 in both NW8/NW4. The removed four warps only handled empty routing ranges; active entry/prefix order is unchanged. MID splits each local expert into jobs<=8; J<=44 fits JMAX88. Zero local routes skips all ring/job accesses while joining and reaching final grid barrier.
review.lifetime: FAST1<=NS2. Helper fills any remaining initial slot; WSB consumer CTA barrier completes slot reads/partial stores before same-slot refill. Partial buffer release follows helper load into registers. Helper credits all owned A units after last A epilogue and before B, so resident CTAs cannot form an A/B dependency cycle. Final WSBL1/2 tails occupy distinct NRB4 slots, and final join preserves helper stores before grid barrier.
review.parity: Each ring slot advances q by NS and each partial buffer advances by NRB; inherited wait parity uses q/NS and q/NRB. At most one pending owner per slot prevents a full phase wrap bypassing an unread value. Independent model checks unique issue/read/release sequences under reordered completion.
review.shared_lifetime: Only TINY+WS+NW4 returns base+skinny workspace. The reachable path has no fat dereference; nF>0 still traps. Two36KiB ring slots fit after rounded metadata27904B, dynamic101632B. Both helper and consumers use this same xbuf base. FINCOL does not reuse extra fat workspace.
review.host_resource_gate: CUDA shared-memory opt-in must succeed and exact BIG false/true occupancy queries at160threads/dynamic101632 must both return>=2 before attr is marked ready. Grid must equal actual queried SM count and small token cap before grid*=2. Both ordinary and PDL launch branches consume this guarded grid. Occupancy includes actual compiled resource constraints; CPU arithmetic alone is not acceptance.
review.PDL: Initial wait, helper joins, launch_dependents placement, release/acquire grid counter and generation lifecycle are inherited. Prior speculative PDL admission cycle remains withdrawn.
review.finalizer_and_scratch: FINCOL FSEG4->8 preserves four columns per thread and complete4096-column coverage. M*FSEG<=128<264 gives at most one segment per active CTA. Small-path reset stride264*128 equals parent132*256; all doneA/ss entries and alternating-generation barrier counters remain covered. WGS-only fixed slots/grid are unchanged.
review.controls: Independent full CUDA preprocessing under14 inherited build combinations matched byte-for-byte; repaired author suite independently rerun validates18 including MAIN_FALLBACK. Renamed extension is observability/cache isolation only.

abstract_schedule.proof_limit: Abstract ownership and phase DAG assuming all CTAs resident; not generated CUDA execution or numerical reduction proof.

limits: CPU native harness validates actual loader/decode/scales/MMA operands, not tensor MMA numerical accumulation, CUDA compiler acceptance, scheduling, hardware memory ordering or performance.
Abstract async model assumes all CTAs resident and inherited release/acquire semantics; a whole-CTA compute step represents all128 consumers and their barrier.

Actual register count/local memory and successful two-CTA admission are not known before official GPU run.128 cached activation registers plus accumulators/pointers may force spills under two-block launch bounds.
Successful compiler warnings may be hidden by load_inline(verbose=False); absence in log_tail does not prove no serialization or spills.
Source still uses parent single-device extension lifetime assumption. Official target is single H200; no new multi-device behavior is claimed.

official_acceptance.correctness: All official tests and benchmarks pass, no rejected flags; retain exact source hash and all terminal records.
official_acceptance.mechanism: Retain OKC_SMALL_NW4 resource markers for actual exercised small extensions; must show both occupancy>=2. Profile names alone do not identify geometry.
official_acceptance.performance: Target>=15% geometric-mean normalized latency reduction over M1/M8/M16; no small case worse by>3%; compare M32/M128/M256 unchanged controls and exact KPERM private/public parent records. A clear regression rejects.
official_acceptance.publication: No scoring or decoder integration from occupancy/source proof alone. A useful standalone result needs fresh exact-source decoder integration review and full-layer check against97af including PDL.
official_acceptance.retries: One check only. No geometry sweeps, unchanged-source repeats or relaxation of gate.
